data.text: Negate enemy's Posture or Empty Posture (enemy may replace with another action; Empty Move is still possible). While sharing a tile, neither may use Posture or Empty Posture.

logic.description: Instant riding on an Attack card against an enemy in contact. A target that declared Posture has it replaced by Empty Posture (their non-instant cast is interrupted; Empty Move stays possible). The paper 'while sharing a tile neither may Posture' clause is not implemented. Rule 8 pc override: returns to hand when the target was not Posturing.

prerequisites.description: The caster's action this turn is an Attack card.
The target is an enemy in contact.

effects.description: The target's action after the grapple: Posture becomes Empty Posture, anything else is unchanged.
Rule 8 pc override: the card returns to hand when the round gave no benefit.
